title: Chapter 2737: Bi Ao
content:
Chapter 2737: Bi Ao

"..."

Liu Yucang’s words stunned both Xu Jiaqi and Qiang Qing Yun. Neither expected him to have such a heartwarming reason for pursuing the leadership position, as they had always assumed he was simply power-hungry because of his rough personality.

After a moment of silence, Yuan asked, "Do you still plan on fighting? Qiang Qing Yun has already decided to step down from the power struggle to support Xu Jiaqi."

"Really?" Xu Jiaqi muttered in surprise upon hearing this for the first time, then turned to Qiang Qing Yun, who nodded to confirm Yuan’s words.

Liu Yucang sighed. "I already told you, I’m not the type to lead others. I’ve been forcing myself to act like an asshole for thousands of years now, and frankly, I’m sick of it."

Hearing this, Qiang Qing Yun couldn’t help but remark, "Are you telling me you’ve been acting like that this entire time because you thought that was what being a leader was supposed to be?"

Liu Yucang shrugged and replied, "I spent most of my earlier years as a soldier, and from what I’ve seen, that kind of personality tends to work best."

"No wonder most of the members under you are mentally weaker than the others," Qiang Qing Yun said, shaking her head.

"W-What is that supposed to mean?!"

"She’s not wrong," Xu Jiaqi said. "Statistically speaking, your recruits cause the most trouble and are usually the ones who start fights. Some people even refer to your group as a band of bandits."

"..."

Liu Yucang fell silent after hearing those words, unable to deny them.

"In any case, since you’ll be stepping down, only that old man is left," Yuan said a moment later. "With all three of you working together, it shouldn’t be that difficult to defeat him, right?"

Xu Jiaqi then said, "Although it’s true that our combined forces within the faction surpass Bi Ao’s group in number and power, we cannot underestimate his influence outside the faction."

"What do you know about him?" Yuan asked.

Xu Jiaqi pondered seriously for a moment before replying, "Honestly, he appeared out of nowhere and quickly rose to prominence within the faction. Before I even realized it, he was already standing beside me as a fellow Celestial Overlord."

"So nobody here knows his background or his intentions, huh?" Yuan looked at the other two, who immediately shook their heads.

Yuan pondered for a moment, then spoke again, "I have an idea about his background and purpose."

"How? Did you know Bi Ao in the past?" Xu Jiaqi inquired.

"No, but when I was Tian Yingzhe, the Celestial Emperor at the time constantly tried to bring me—and by extension, the Celestial Overlords—directly under his command. Essentially, he wanted us to become something like Heaven’s Mandate without officially becoming part of his military."

"The Celestial Emperor had been persistent for years, but then, one day, he suddenly stopped. I haven’t heard a single word from him since."

After a brief pause, Yuan continued, "If I had to gamble on it, I’d bet that Bi Ao was planted by the Celestial Emperor to seize control of the faction from within."

"The Celestial Emperor is involved in our faction’s power struggle?!" Liu Yucang could hardly believe it.

"It’s definitely possible..." Xu Jiaqi muttered with a serious frown on her face.

"But why our faction specifically?" Qiang Qing Yun wondered aloud. "Although we’re certainly one of the top factions in the Nine Heavens, there are still factions stronger than us."

Xu Jiaqi then said, "At the time Bi Ao joined us, the Celestial Overlords were the most powerful and influential faction in the Nine Heavens. None of the others even came close."

"Who’s to say we’re the only faction he’s infiltrated?" Yuan remarked. "For all we know, he could be doing the same thing to the others."

"If that’s the case, we should warn the other factions and confront the Celestial Emperor together," Liu Yucang said. "To prevent them from having too much power, Celestial Emperors are prohibited from controlling any faction or large group that isn’t Heaven’s Mandate."

Xu Jiaqi sneered at such words and said, "How naive. Even if we confront the Celestial Emperor, do you really think he’d admit to it? I highly doubt there would be any evidence, either."

Yuan then said, "Putting the other factions aside for now, since we have no confirmation that they’ve been infiltrated, all we need to do is defeat Bi Ao to put an end to their plans. It probably won’t be easy, but with the three of you working together, I don’t believe you’ll lose to him."

"Or we could save ourselves the trouble and just kill that old man outright," Liu Yucang said, slamming one fist into his open palm with an excited grin.

Xu Jiaqi rubbed her eyes and sighed. "You can’t be serious... It won’t end with Bi Ao’s death. His followers definitely won’t accept it and leave quietly. They’ll retaliate, and that will only lead to a bloodbath within the faction. As much as I want to get rid of Bi Ao, I don’t want to do it at the cost of our members’ lives."

"Is violence all you can think about?" Qiang Qing Yun shook her head.

Xu Jiaqi then said, "In any case, I’ll deal with Bi Ao myself."

She turned to Yuan and continued, "This may sound strange, but I want you to stay out of this and simply watch as a spectator. I want to prove to you that I’m qualified to lead the faction—not merely because of our relationship."

Yuan nodded with a smile.

"Of course."

After talking a little more, Yuan said, "It’s about time for me to leave. I was on my way to Gates of Heaven before I was brought here against my will, after all."

"Gates of Heaven?" Xu Jiaqi raised an eyebrow. "What business do you have there? If you’re looking for Bai Ling, I can summon him for you."

Yuan shook his head before explaining, "I need to be there to participate in some race."
